title: PRISM2 model uses clinical dialogue to interpret pathology slides
slides: Can AI read your biopsy like a doctor?
PRISM2 learns from clinical conversations, not just images.
It spots subtle patterns no human eye catches.
Your next pathology report may be AI-reviewed.
Ask your lab if PRISM2 is in use.
thread_text:
1. What if AI reads your biopsy?

PRISM2 doesn't just look at images—it learns from clinical conversations, catching what eyes miss.

2. Patterns invisible to humans

It spots subtle changes in tissue that no pathologist has been trained to see, changing the diagnostic game.

3. The learning secret

PRISM2's edge comes from training on doctor-patient dialogues, not just scans—a novel approach that boosts accuracy.

4. Your report's new reviewer

Soon, every pathology report could get an AI second pass, flagging risks before they become crises.

5. Ask your lab this week

Call your lab and ask: 'Is PRISM2 in use?' If not, ask why—your diagnosis might depend on it.

instagram.caption:
Your biopsy report might get a second opinion from a model trained on doctor-patient chats, not just tissue scans 🧠

PRISM2 learns from clinical dialogue to read pathology slides, spotting subtle patterns in tissue that human eyes aren't trained to see. It’s a new layer of review, not a replacement—accuracy gets a boost where it counts most.

For anyone waiting on a pathology result, this could mean earlier flags on risks that would otherwise slip through. Labs that adopt it change how your diagnosis is double-checked.

Next time you’re at your lab, ask straight: “Is PRISM2 reviewing my slides?” If not, what are they using instead? 🩺🔬
